compiler_only_output.reason: The factories' `new daUdlift_c()` runs the implicit derived C2, which calls the base subobject destructor D2 as vague linkage when the compiler cannot inline it away. The cartridge keeps only _ZN10dBgActor_cD1Ev (ov002:0x020ee42c) and _ZN10dBgActor_cD0Ev (ov002:0x020ee464) and has no dBgActor_c D2 at all, so this copy has no canonical owner and is simply discarded.

include/types.h gives Vector3 an empty inline destructor, so every TU that destroys a Vector3 local re-emits it with vague linkage; the Vector3 locals in StateStop and StateStopAtBottom do so here, as their legacy one-function objects already did. The cartridge keeps exactly one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, kind:function(arm,size=0x4), and src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp is its enrolled `complete` owner of that 0x020072c0..0x020072c4 range. This object's copy is the identical 4-byte `bx lr` body with no relocations; rombuild compares the body against those cartridge bytes before discarding the duplicate.
